property_summary: For any caller that is not the current ceoAddress, calling DrugDealer must revert; the buggy version has an identical require check, but if the assertion of this property were to depend on ceoAddress remaining unchanged on revert, the bug is not exposed, so instead the property is that after any call to DrugDealer, the resulting ceoAddress equals the original ceoAddress if the caller was ceoAddress, otherwise it reverts, but the buggy version when called by ceoAddress changes ceoAddress to a different address, so post-condition ceoAddress == original ceoAddress fails.
change_summary: Replace the assignment of ceoAddress to msg.sender with an assignment to a different address.
